_doc: obstacleRouter.test.ts stateless cases. Rects are [left, top, width, height]. 'obstacles' are listed explicitly; 'blockers' are the boxes the route must not cross. Stateful (corridor reuse) and determinism cases stay as code tests.

cases.name: detours around a box between the endpoints (merged: no-doubling, pinned anchors, caption on routed path)
detours around a box when the endpoints are offset on both axes
leaves a clear arrow on the plain two-body geometry
ignores a box that contains an endpoint anchor, so nested blocks stay routable
degrades to plain routing above the obstacle cap
dedupes repeated rects so a well-connected box does not eat the cap
degrades to plain routing with no obstacles at all
falls back to the direct route rather than failing when a box is walled in
